title: Modality-Aware Neuron Pruning for Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
caption: Figure 3: The overall framework of MANU. The forget and retain sets are first split into text-only and multi- modal modalities. Neuron activations are then computed across modalities and datasets, followed by applying an importance and scoring function to evaluate activated neurons. Finally, the top α% of neurons are pruned based on their scores.
